fact_text: The Temporary Resident visa is applied for at a Mexican consular office abroad before travelling to Mexico; it is not first obtained inside the country.
evidence_quote: Este tipo de visa puede solicitarse directamente en cualquier representación consular de México

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you sort out residence after arriving in Mexico. Actually the Temporary Resident visa is issued by a Mexican consulate abroad first. Action: book the consular appointment in the home/current country before the move.

entity_title: Work authorization on Temporary Resident visa
fact_text: A Temporary Resident visa holder may work in Mexico only if the salary is paid abroad; it does not by itself authorize a locally-paid job.
evidence_quote: le permite al extranjero trabajar en nuestro país, siempre y cuando el salario que perciba sea pagado en el extranjero

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed any Temporary Resident can take a Mexican payroll job. Actually the visa permits work only if the salary is paid from abroad. Action: if the employee will be on Mexican payroll, use the INM job-offer authorization route instead.

fact_text: If the foreigner has a Mexican job offer and will be paid in Mexico, the employer must petition INM directly for authorization to issue the visa.
evidence_quote: En caso de contar con una oferta de empleo en México y recibir su salario en territorio nacional, la empresa o persona física deberá gestionar directamente ante el Instituto Nacional de Migración

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the employee alone applies for the work visa. Actually for a Mexico-paid role the employer must file the visa authorization with INM. Action: start the employer-side INM petition early, as the consular visa depends on it.

fact_text: After entering Mexico, the foreigner must process the residence card at INM within 30 calendar days of entry to certify legal stay.
evidence_quote: la persona extranjera deberá tramitar dentro de los siguientes 30 días naturales contados a partir de su ingreso al territorio nacional, la tarjeta de residencia que acredite su estancia legal

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the consular visa is the final document. Actually you have only 30 calendar days after entry to exchange it for the residence card at INM. Action: schedule the INM canje appointment immediately on arrival.

entity_title: Canje: exchange visa for residence card
fact_text: The visitor-for-exchange entry document (FMM) tied to the consular visa is exchanged (canje) at INM for the Tarjeta de Residente, which is the actual residence card.
evidence_quote: Canje de FMM por Tarjeta de Visitante o de Residente

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the visa sticker is the residence permit. Actually the entry FMM must undergo canje at INM to become the Tarjeta de Residente. Action: bring passport, FMM, consular visa, completed basic format and fee proof to the canje.

fact_text: Before hiring or extending a job offer to a foreigner, the employer (individual or company) must first obtain the employer registration certificate (Constancia de Inscripción de Empleador) from INM.
evidence_quote: Si eres una persona física o moral y deseas contratar personal extranjero, debes obtener tu Constancia de Inscripción de Empleador

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed only the foreign worker files paperwork. Actually the employer must be registered with INM as an employer before any work-visa offer. Action: confirm the Mexican entity holds a current Constancia before promising a start date.

fact_text: The job offer supporting the work visa must be on letterhead and state the occupation (per the national occupations classification), required duration, workplace and remuneration, tying the authorization to that specific role.
evidence_quote: la oferta de empleo en papel membretado en la que señale la ocupación que desarrollará la persona extranjera conforme a la clasificación del Sistema Nacional de Clasificación de Ocupaciones

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the work permit is portable across roles. Actually it is tied to the offered occupation, employer, workplace and pay stated in the offer. Action: re-file with INM if the role, employer or work location changes.

entity_title: Work permit does not validate credentials
fact_text: Being granted a work permit or paid-activity status does not amount to validation of the foreigner's certifications, licenses, degrees or professional titles.
evidence_quote: no implica validación de certificaciones, licencias, títulos, permisos, anuencias u otros similares

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a Mexican work permit means your professional credentials are recognized. Actually the permit is separate from any professional license or title recognition. Action: pursue separate revalidation/registration for any regulated profession.

fact_text: Temporary and permanent foreign residents are entitled to a CURP; INM assigns it automatically once it issues the foreigner's Unique Number (NUE), with no separate CURP application.
evidence_quote: Una vez que el Instituto Nacional de Migración asigne el Número Único de Extranjeros (NUE) de conformidad con su marco normativo aplicable, asignará de manera automática la CURP.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed foreigners must separately apply for a CURP. Actually INM assigns it automatically when it issues the NUE on the residence card. Action: use the CURP from the residence-card process for banking, RFC and other services.

fact_text: A foreign individual residing in Mexico registers in the Federal Taxpayer Registry (RFC); the valid migration document issued by the competent authority serves as identification for the registration.
evidence_quote: Personas físicas extranjeras que requieran inscribirse en el RFC.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed only a passport is needed for a Mexican tax ID. Actually foreigners register in the RFC using their migration document as identification. Action: obtain the residence card first, then register for RFC to be put on payroll.

fact_text: Regardless of nationality, an individual is a Mexican tax resident if they have established their home (casa habitación) in Mexico; where they also keep a home abroad, they are resident if their centre of vital interests is in Mexico (CFF Art. 9).
evidence_quote: Las que hayan establecido su casa habitación en México.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a short assignment keeps you taxed only at home. Actually establishing a home in Mexico can make you a Mexican tax resident on worldwide income. Action: assess tax residency and any treaty tie-breaker before relocating.

fact_text: It is the employer's obligation to enrol every worker in IMSS social security with their real salary; failing to do so damages the worker's social-security coverage and health rights.
evidence_quote: su obligación de inscribir a toda persona trabajadora con el salario que percibe realmente

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the employee arranges their own health cover. Actually the employer must register the worker with IMSS from the start of employment, which unlocks public healthcare. Action: confirm the IMSS alta is filed on day one of employment.
